title: UN Pooled Funds in IATI: the inter-agency pooled funds the UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office administers, activity by activity
provider: The UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office (UNDP), publishing as UN Pooled Funds (XI-IATI-UNPF) to the International Aid Transparency Initiative; read activity by activity through d-portal, https://d-portal.org/q.xml?aid=<identifier>
credit: UN Pooled Funds (XI-IATI-UNPF), the UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office, via the IATI Registry and d-portal
format: IATI Activity Standard 2.03 XML: a fund as one activity (its contributors as funding organisations, their contributions as incoming funds) and each joint programme as a child activity (its participating UN organisations, its recipient country, the fund's transfers). Read by data/formats/iati.py; written as the diplomacy domain's records by data/products/multilateral_cases.py. No results are published for the Migration MPTF's programmes.
coverage: About 10,000 activities of the funds the Office administers (the IATI Dashboard, 2026). The first case read is the Migration MPTF, XI-IATI-UNPF-MPTF00193 and its fifteen children (read 2026-11-19).
licence: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (ODC-PDDL), the publisher's statement on the IATI Registry (dataset unpf-data, checked 2026-11-19). Fetched into data/cache/iati/ and never committed.
citation: UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office, UN Pooled Funds activity file (XI-IATI-UNPF), International Aid Transparency Initiative, via d-portal.org.
